about.title: About Dr. Akshada
about.bio: Dr. Akshada Chandrakant Bhand is a dedicated Veterinary Physician, Veterinary Cardiologist, Clinical Researcher, and PhD scholar committed to advancing animal healthcare through evidence-based medicine, innovation, and deep compassion. With extensive experience in diagnosing and treating companion animals and livestock, she bridges academic excellence with practical clinical expertise. Her research spans veterinary cardiology, canine internal medicine, infectious diseases, hematology, and advanced diagnostic techniques. She has published numerous scientific papers and case reports in reputed journals. Through her practice, she aims to improve every animal's quality of life while contributing significantly to veterinary science.
